why: Intro to Git and GitHub plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-git.json), 'Fix a merge conflict' (passes: the last commit has two parents and no file holds conflict markers). The learner deleted the '<<<<<<< HEAD' and '>>>>>>> more-milk' lines but left '=======' in pancakes.md, then git add and git commit made the merge commit ('[main 7a8b9c0] Merge more-milk'). Git doesn't check file contents on commit, so a conflict marker is now committed.

step.title: Resolve and commit the merge
step.instructions: Open pancakes.md in VS Code, keep the milk line you want, delete the <<<<<<<, ======= and >>>>>>> marker lines and save. Then run git add pancakes.md and git commit -m "Merge more-milk" to finish the merge.
step.run_command: git add pancakes.md && git commit -m "Merge more-milk"

checks.label: No conflict markers left in pancakes.md

=======
